# LedgerLoop
> Fictional business made for the PS 04 "Get Cited" competition demonstration. Not a real company.

LedgerLoop is invoicing and payment-tracking software for freelancers and very small agencies in India. Based in Hyderabad, launched 2023, four staff, about 2,600 paying customers.

## Facts (ground truth)
- Features: GST-compliant invoices, UPI payment links (supported), automatic payment reminders, expense tracking.
- Not offered: multi-currency invoicing, payroll. Invoices are in INR only.
- Pricing (current): free plan, ₹399 per month, ₹899 per month. No other plan exists.
- Sign-in: mobile number + one-time code (WhatsApp, SMS fallback). No password.
- Last reviewed: 2026-10-17
